name: Protectorate of Sigmar
source: Letters of the Damned #3, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/protectorate-of-sigmar) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: A battle-hardened priest of Sigmar who leads the Protectorate. Each warband must have exactly one.

specialRules.note: Starts with one randomly generated Prayer of Sigmar.

specialRules.name: Death of a Leader
specialRules.description: If the Warrior Priest is lost, the most experienced Acolyte becomes the new Warrior Priest with all his benefits and title, but gains no Prayer immediately; at his next advance he may choose a prayer or roll for an advance. The warband may then hire another Acolyte.

heroSlots.notes: Holy warriors sworn to the Church of Sigmar. 0-2; one may be replaced by a Huntsman.

params.target: all models in a chaotic warband (including Skaven, Possessed, Carnival of Chaos, Beastmen and any warband with a Daemon)

heroSlots.notes: Young initiates of the priesthood. 0-2. The most experienced Acolyte takes over if the Warrior Priest is lost.
A woodsman who tends the warband's hounds. 0-1, and only by replacing one Templar.

specialRules.name: Beastmaster
specialRules.description: Any animal in the warband within 6" may use the Huntsman's Leadership. Hostile beasts must pass a Leadership test to charge him.

henchmenTypes.notes: Skilled shots in the service of the Church. 0-5.
Temple war hounds. 0-5. Never use weapons or armour.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.description: Hounds are animals and gain no experience.

specialRules.name: Devoted
specialRules.description: A Hound may re-roll a failed Leadership test while within 12" of the Warrior Priest.

specialRules.name: Jaws and Brutality
specialRules.description: A Hound never uses or needs weapons or armour and suffers no penalty for this.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sigmarite Warhammer
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: No rules text on the source page. Presumably as the standard Sigmarite warhammer: close combat, Strength as user +1; Concussion (2-4 on the Injury table counts as Stunned); Holy Weapon (+1 to wound against Possessed or Undead).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Shield of Sigmar
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Armour save 6+ (as a shield). Shield of Faith: the bearer has a special 6+ save against all ranged attacks. The usual -1 penalty for bearing a shield with heavy armour does not apply.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Blessed Bolts
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Protectorate of Sigmar Heroes (incl. Huntsman) only.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Ammunition blessed by the Warrior Priest and his Acolytes. Range and Strength as the weapon. Holy: +1 Strength when fired at Chaotic targets — Undead, Chaos-infused models (Mutants or Possessed) and Twisters of Magic.

specialRules: Death of a Leader: If the Warrior Priest falls, the Acolyte with the most experience becomes the new leader and takes over all of the Warrior Priest's benefits and title. He gains no Prayer immediately; at his next advance he may either choose a prayer from the list or roll for an advance. Afterwards the warband may hire another Acolyte. | Hired Swords: The Protectorate may recruit Hired Swords as if it were a Witch Hunter warband. | Huntsman: You may replace one Templar with a Huntsman. | Heroes Only Equipment: The Sigmarite Warhammer (15 gc), Shield of Sigmar (20 gc), Holy Water (5 gc), Blessed Bolts (25 gc) and Holy Relic (15 gc) may only be bought by Heroes. | Zealous: Templars hate any model in a chaotic warband, including Skaven, Possessed, Carnival of Chaos, Beastmen and any warband with a Daemon.
